cells.gaps: The 448,243 refugees and asylum-seekers of March 2024 are registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them; the World Bank says refugees are disproportionately without recognised ID. The 78% SIM share mixes refugees and hosts.
cells.note: Stage 2: refugees are registered and biometric registration for cash transfers has begun, but no source says documents were issued, so question 2 is unmet. Refugees hold SIMs in their own name, but each step must be met, so not 3 or 4.
